title: The Nine Hazels Voyage
tagline: A grand sailing adventure across the Seas of Knowing
description: An original seafaring saga in the spirit of classic adventure anime: an original crew, an uncharted sea, and nine legendary hazel islands, each hiding a fragment of the Salmon's knowledge. Perfect for learners who love One Piece-style voyages, pirates, and found-family crews.
worldPrompt: An original grand sailing adventure across the mythical Seas of Knowing. The learner's crew sails the Hazeline Sea hunting nine legendary hazel islands, each holding a fragment of the Salmon of Knowledge. Rival crews, sea mysteries, island trials, and a found-family crew of original characters. Map the subject's units onto the voyage: each unit is one island's trial.
